name: set_ticket_tags
title: Set ticket tags
description: Add tags to a ticket and remove tags from it, by name. Name only the tags to add or remove; the others stay. Names are matched to the existing tags without regard to case; a name that matches none adds nothing and the answer names the closest tags, so ask the user which one they mean. Set create_new_tags only when the user asked for a new tag; Zammad creates it only where the user may. list_tags lists the tags there are.

create_new_tags.description: Create the tags to add that do not exist yet. Only when the user asked for a new tag.

ticket_number.description: The ticket number as shown in Zammad, e.g. "31042" or "Ticket#31042".

ticket_id.description: The internal ID of the ticket, e.g. 8812.

ticket_url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

already_set.description: Tags to add the ticket had already.

not_set.description: Tags to remove the ticket did not have.

created.description: Tags that did not exist and were created.
